title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
About Us : Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting‑edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.

The Role :

As Vendry’s Accounts Receivable Specialist , you’ll play a crucial operational and financial role ensuring that our revenue engine runs smoothly, accurately, and transparently. You’ll be responsible for managing our referral fee collection process—working directly with our agency partners to confirm contract terms, validate deal data, and ensure timely and accurate payments.

Beyond the core AR workflow, this role is also instrumental in strengthening Vendry’s internal financial operations. You’ll support our accounting processes, help categorize transactions correctly, maintain clean records across our systems, assist with P&L and reporting needs, and identify opportunities to streamline and improve how we operate as an organization.

This is a highly collaborative role that sits at the intersection of finance, operations, and partner relations. You’ll be a key part of ensuring Vendry is running efficiently, sustainably, and with complete clarity into our financial performance.

Responsibilities :

Manage the end-to-end accounts receivable process, including tracking referral-fee–eligible deals and verifying all contract and payment data with agency partners.

Collaborate with agencies to collect invoices, confirm terms, and reconcile discrepancies quickly and professionally.

Maintain accurate financial records and ensure all transactions are properly categorized in accounting systems.

Support monthly P&Ls, reporting workflows, and ad-hoc financial analysis as needed.

Continuously evaluate and improve Vendry’s internal financial processes, tools, and documentation.

Work closely with the Agency Operations and Leadership teams to ensure alignment between deal data, contract terms, and revenue expectations.

Maintain up-to-date documentation in our internal systems to support transparency, compliance, and decision-making.

Assist with broader operational improvements as Vendry scales—including identifying bottlenecks, proposing solutions, and helping implement them.

Qualifications :

2–4 years of experience in accounts receivable, financial operations, accounting support, or a similar role.

Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and AR best practices.

Excellent English proficiency (verbal and written) and strong communication skills, especially when working with U.S.-based teams and partners.

Experience working with U.S. startups, agencies, or marketing organizations is strongly preferred.

Comfort working with financial tools, spreadsheets, accounting platforms, and internal operations systems.

Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—able to manage multiple workflows with accuracy and follow-through.

Experience working remotely; able to collaborate asynchronously and manage your own schedule effectively.

Based in Brazil and able to work full-time remotely.

Why Join Vendry :

Joining Vendry means becoming part of a fast-growing team committed to transforming how brands discover and work with top‑tier agencies. You’ll play a foundational role in strengthening the systems that allow our business to scale—helping ensure our financial engine is accurate, efficient, and ready for growth.

We’re a collaborative, fast‑moving team that values operational excellence, clear communication, and initiative. You’ll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact on how the company runs day‑to‑day, while building deep experience in finance and operations within a modern, tech‑powered startup.

If you’re detail-driven, process-oriented, and excited about supporting a high-growth company through strong financial operations, we’d love to hear from you.

We are looking to hire a Railway Electrical Engineer to join our Rail team in Spain.

The selected candidate will be responsible for providing technical leadership in the design of airfields for large-scale international airport projects.

At IDOM, we offer you the opportunity to develop your professional career by actively participating in national and international projects that will challenge you to improve every day, in a collaborative and team-oriented environment. ABOUT YOU

Don't hesitate to apply if...

  • You preferably have a degree in Electrical Engineering.

The ability to work in multidisciplinary and international environments will be valued.

  • You are fluent in English (minimum level B2/C1) (spoken and written); other languages will be valued.
  • You are a team player, autonomous, flexible, technically rigorous, and internationally minded.
  • And above all... you are eager to learn in an international company like IDOM

ABOUT US

IDOM is an association of professionals whose activity focuses on carrying out engineering, architecture, and consulting projects that contribute to a more sustainable world. The people at IDOM are

connected by our work and by our ownership of the firm, and we cooperate to achieve our greatest professional and personal development and the best service for our clients.

That is why IDOM's core asset is the value and experience of its people. Highly qualified professionals with strong human qualities, deeply united, who work in an environment of respect for their professional identity and freedom, with a strong ambition for progress, development, service, and innovation.

Since our founding in 1957, we have grown steadily and are now a multidisciplinary, integrated, international organization with a presence in 130 countries, where more than 4,300 people carry out our professional activities.

Are you ready to take the next step?

If you join our TEAM, you will be able to develop your career at the highest level, in an environment of deep trust and professional respect.

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
At bunny.net (Permanent)

Expires at:

Remote policy: Global remote

Senior Infrastructure Engineer (Europe)

Our network doesn’t just move fast, it hops. We handle millions of requests every second across 120+ PoPs on six continents, powering not just a lightning-fast CDN, but also a global Edge Computing platform, Streaming services, and petabyte-scale Storage.

As our footprint expands, so does the challenge, and the fun. That’s where you come in.

As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer, you’ll design and shape the global infrastructure that makes bunny.net hop. You’ll work with bare metal and virtual servers, core internal applications like databases and internal tools, and the supporting infrastructure that ties it all together. You’ll have the autonomy to set the scope and delivery of your projects, but you’ll also thrive in collaboration, sharing knowledge, providing feedback, and teaming up to tackle complex challenges.

Your work will reduce busywork, speed up global deployments, and strengthen how bunny.net runs at every level.

What will you do?

  • Run and expand our hybrid infrastructure across 120+ PoPs, keeping it fast, reliable, and resilient
  • Solve complex challenges in large-scale distributed systems and networking stacks
  • Automate the boring stuff, reducing toil and streamlining server setup worldwide
  • Level up our monitoring game with meaningful metrics, alerts, and dashboards that keep us ahead of issues
  • Collaborate across teams to support new products, features, and big ideas with infrastructure expertise
  • Own the systems you build, participating in a follow-the-sun on-call rotation to keep everything performing at its best
  • Create tools and pipelines that make the team more efficient and the platform more powerful

Main requirements

What will you bring?

  • Proven experience running large-scale, multi-regional Linux-based hybrid infrastructures
  • Strong understanding of core internet building blocks like DNS, HTTP, and TLS (you’ve tinkered with things like nginx, TLS ciphers, and HTTP / 2 before)
  • Bare-metal expertise, from setup and operation to securing and debugging servers, even if they’re halfway across the globe
  • A growth mindset with eagerness to learn, adapt, and shape the future of a fast-moving technical stack, especially with a focus on reliability
  • A love for automation and Infrastructure-as-Code to eliminate repetitive work
  • Hands‑on experience with monitoring systems like metrics, alerts, logs, and runbooks (we run our own Prometheus exporters, craft our own Grafana dashboards, and write the alerts we respond to)
  • Solid networking skills, VLANs, routing, TCP / IP, DHCP, IPv6 all feel familiar to you
  • Experience running SQL / NoSQL databases like MariaDB, Elasticsearch, Redis, or Cassandra
  • Ability to write tools and scripts in Bash, Python, or Go

Where should you be located?

Fully remote across Europe — work from where you hop best.

Nice to have

What will make us extra happy?

  • Experience with CDNs, edge computing, streaming platforms, or object storage projects
  • A passion for observability, with a good understanding of how systems behave as a whole, not just checking if they’re “healthy”
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks and using them to introduce meaningful, lasting improvements
  • Hands‑on involvement in network design, implementation, and monitoring (BGP, Spine‑Leaf, Anycast are all in your vocabulary)
  • Deep experience tuning and scaling databases such as MariaDB or Cassandra in high‑traffic environments.
  • Experience in Disaster Recovery or Business Continuity Planning (and ready to help shape bunny.net’s DR strategy)
  • Skills in hardware performance tuning, from NIC queues to flamegraphs and performance dashboards

Benefits & Perks

What's in it for you?

Life at bunny.net comes with benefits that make work (and life) better.

100% flexible hours - Your work, your rhythm. Whether you thrive at 3 am or on a beach at noon, we've got you.

Remote‑first by design - No offices, no commute, just the freedom to work anywhere. Miss the office? We’ll give you a 3-night voucher for visiting our headquarters.

Performance‑based bonuses - Great work pays off, and we reward impact annually.

Medical, dental, and vision insurance - Coverage worldwide.

Paid time off - Love the slopes or the sea? Enjoy them with 25 vacation days, plus an extra loyalty day each year, capped at 5 years (30 days total), on top of your local public holidays.

Meeting‑free Thursdays - We keep Thursdays meeting free internally so you can focus on deep work without interruptions.

Home office budget - We believe everyone is more efficient working in a comfortable office, and we're happy to help you set it up with an annual budget of €500.

Paid sick leave - Feeling ill? Take time off to fully recover without having to worry about your finances.

Parental leave - Paid 16 weeks for birthing parents, 8 weeks for non‑birthing parents. If your country gives more, that’s your baseline. If it gives less, we top it up. Take your leave all at once or split it across the first year for maximum flexibility. After paid leave, your local statutory rules apply.

Annual fluffle‑building - We're remote, but not distant! Once a year, we meet in a sunny location where virtual high‑fives turn into real ones.

Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP) - Everyone at bunny.net gets a piece of the pie, starting with 0.01% equity.

Mental health support - Feeling down? We've got your back. bunny.net provides mental health resources and help via BetterHelp.com.

Wellness budget - An annual well‑being budget of €480 is here to help you stay fresh and focused.

Educational budget - €500 yearly for books, seminars, or online courses to keep your learning on track, work‑related or not.

Music on us - Work is better with music. Enjoy a yearly Apple, Spotify, or YouTube Premium subscription on us.

description:

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O seu desafio como Senior AI Engineer :

Você será o pilar de engenharia da Tribo de Dados & IA. Sua missão vai muito além de codar : esperamos que você transforme protótipos de IA em produtos de software robustos, escaláveis e observáveis. Você será a referência técnica para garantir que nossas soluções (como assistentes jurídicos e sistemas de extração de dados) funcionem em produção com alta disponibilidade.

Suas principais responsabilidades :

Engenharia de Sistemas de IA (AI Engineering) :

Arquitetar e desenvolver o backend de aplicações baseadas em LLMs, garantindo que elas sejam rápidas, custo-eficientes e confiáveis.

Implementar pipelines de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) de ponta a ponta, cuidando desde a ingestão e chunking inteligente de dados até a estratégia de recuperação e geração de resposta.

Criar e manter Agentes Autônomos que realizam tarefas complexas, garantindo que tenham mecanismos de controle, memória e tratamento de erros (para evitar loops infinitos ou alucinações).

Liderança Técnica “Hands-on” :

Atuar como Tech Lead natural da squad : liderar definições de arquitetura, conduzir Code Reviews rigorosos (focados em design patterns e performance) e elevar a barra técnica do time.

Mentorar engenheiros plenos e juniores através de pair programming e discussões técnicas, ajudando a desbloquear problemas complexos do dia a dia.

Excelência Operacional & Cloud (AWS) :

Assumir a propriedade da infraestrutura das suas aplicações (“You build it, you run it”). Isso inclui saber arquitetar soluções na AWS e otimizar custos de inferência.

Garantir a observabilidade total dos sistemas : implementar logs estruturados, métricas e tracing (para debugar cadeias de LangChain / agentes em produção).

Automação Inteligente :

Desenvolver crawlers e bots robustos para captura de dados em larga escala, integrando essas automações diretamente com nossos pipelines de IA para enriquecimento de dados em tempo real.

Colaboração e Produto :

Trabalhar lado a lado com Product Managers e Designers para traduzir problemas de negócio vagos em soluções técnicas viáveis.

Ter a autonomia para questionar requisitos, propor simplificações e defender a qualidade do software contra prazos irrealistas (negociando débito técnico de forma consciente).

Requisitos e qualificações

O que buscamos (Hard Skills & Ferramentas) :

Para essa cadeira, buscamos um perfil de Engenharia de Software (Backend) com especialização em IA Generativa. Não procuramos apenas quem “consome APIs”, mas quem constrói sistemas resilientes ao redor delas.

Python Moderno & Engenharia Robusta :

Proficiência avançada em Python.

Domínio de Pydantic para validação de dados e FastAPI para construção de APIs assíncronas de alto desempenho.

Experiência com gerenciamento profissional de pacotes (Poetry ou uv) e ferramentas de qualidade de código.

Arquitetura de IA Generativa & Agentes :

Experiência sólida na construção de fluxos de IA com LangChain e, preferencialmente, orquestração de estado com LangGraph.

Capacidade de desenhar e implementar arquiteturas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) que vão além do básico : conhecimento prático de Hybrid Search (Vetorial + Keyword) e estratégias de Reranking (ex : Cohere, BGE) para garantir precisão.

Engenharia de Software & Cloud (AWS) :

Mentalidade de “You build it, you run it”. Experiência provisionando e mantendo infraestrutura em AWS (ECS, Lambda, SQS).

Domínio de Docker e familiaridade com Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform ou CDK).

Design de sistemas distribuídos e orientados a eventos (Event-driven), essenciais para lidar com fluxos de agentes assíncronos.

Automação & Extração de Dados :

Experiência com frameworks de automação de browser (foco em Playwright Async) para tarefas complexas de extração de dados e interação com sistemas legados.

Qualificação Necessária :

Experiência : Pelo menos 5+ anos de experiência prática em desenvolvimento de software (Backend), com os últimos anos focados ou transicionando para projetos de IA / Dados.

Formação : Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas (ou experiência prática equivalente comprovada).

Metodologia : Vivência real em ambientes ágeis (Scrum / Kanban) com foco em entrega contínua.

Diferenciais (O que faz seus olhos brilharem) :

Se você tiver estes conhecimentos, você estará um passo à frente para liderar nossas iniciativas mais ambiciosas :

Sistemas Multi-Agentes (MAS) : Experiência prática construindo sistemas onde múltiplos agentes colaboram autonomamente. Familiaridade com Google ADK ou padrões agênticos como ReAct , Plan-and-Execute e loops de auto-correção ( Reflection ).

RAG de Próxima Geração : Conhecimento ou interesse em GraphRAG (uso de Knowledge Graphs para capturar relacionamentos complexos) e Self-RAG (agentes que avaliam a própria recuperação).

Otimização de LLMs & SLMs :

Experiência rodando modelos locais (Phi-3, Llama-3, Gemma) para otimização de custos.

Uso de DSPy para otimização programática de prompts (substituindo a engenharia de prompt manual).

Avaliação de modelos (LLM-as-a-Judge) com frameworks como Ragas ou DeepEval.

Ecossistema Web : Conhecimento em Node.js / Typescript ;para eventuais manutenções em interfaces ou integração com BFFs.

Position Summary

Executar manutenções mecânicas preventivas, preditivas e corretivas em máquinas, instalações e equipamentos industriais, assim como trabalhos de solda, lubrificação e intervenções mecânicas, elétricas, eletrônicas, hidráulicas e pneumáticas, baseando-se em planos de manutenção e ordens de serviços apresentadas pela operação, realizando as análises e intervenções devidas, assim como os devidos testes funcionais até garantir a continuidade da operação sem riscos aos operadores e ao processo. Auxiliam os engenheiros em projetos, programas, controle, instalação e manutenção de sistemas de automação. Analisam especificações para aquisição de componentes e equipamentos. Realizar alinhamento de precisão baseado em padrão definido pela Bridgestone.

Responsibilities

  • Efetuar trabalhos de melhorias contínuas das máquinas, verificando as necessidades de aperfeiçoamento de peças e/ou de adaptações viáveis, analisando as melhores formas de inovações, elaborando desenhos e croquis e submetendo ao superior para aprovação, visando garantir melhor rendimento das máquinas;
  • Instalar peças fabricadas nas máquinas, efetuando os serviços de montagem, fazendo os testes manuais e automáticos junto ao operador, efetuando as regulagens e ajustes necessários, para certificar-se da resistência de funcionamento da peça fabricada e de sua funcionalidade operacional;

  • Proceder a análises de diagramas hidráulicos e pneumáticos, interpretando o funcionamento dos circuitos, realizando a devida detecção de falhas de peças e suas causas raiz de problemas, visando programação do melhor processo de manutenção.

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner.   • Big news : Gympass is now Wellhub!

This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior Data Scientist in our Generative AI area in Portugal ! This is a Remote – Portugal position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Portugal.

YOUR IMPACT

Multimodal Extraction : Apply state-of-the-art tools (OCR, vision-language models, document understanding frameworks) to interpret diverse input types;

Prompt Engineering : Develop and refine strategies for using LLMs to extract, summarize, and transform unstructured content into structured formats;

Data Quality & Structuring : Clean, validate, and transform messy, unstructured data into well-defined schemas ready for use in training or analytics pipelines;

Content Filtering : Define standards and build systems for cleaning, validating, and filtering data to ensure accuracy, reduce bias, and align with ethical / safety guidelines;

Human-in-the-Loop Feedback : Design feedback loops where experts validate or enrich data, improving LLM-based extraction reliability;

Scalability & Optimization : Architect cost-efficient, high-throughput data pipelines that are robust to noisy or incomplete sources;

Research & Prototyping : Experiment with emerging tools and methods in the LLM + multimodal space, exploring new ways to enhance information coverage and extraction reliability;

Collaboration : Partner with data engineers and other data scientists to integrate collected data into larger AI and analytics systems;

Live the mission : inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

Main requirements

WHO YOU ARE

  • Master’s degree (or PhD) in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field;
  • Proficiency in Python and experience with libraries for web scraping, OCR (e.g., Tesseract, EasyOCR), and NLP (e.g., HuggingFace Transformers);
  • Deep understanding of LLM capabilities in multimodal and extraction contexts, including prompt engineering and few-shot learning;
  • Strong background in unstructured data processing : APIs, web scraping, HTML parsing, OCR, image / document analysis;
  • Strong analytical problem-solving skills, with a track record of turning noisy data into high-quality datasets for ML;
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills, with the ability to influence across technical and product teams.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in data science and Python are mandatory requirements.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with visual-language models (e.g., BLIP, Donut, or LayoutLM) and multimodal pipelines;
  • Hands-on experience in prompt engineering and few-shot learning for data extraction tasks;
  • Experience deploying or supporting data acquisition systems in production environments.

Benefits & Perks

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our benefits include :

  • WELLHUB : We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.
  • FITNESS : Additional fitness subsidy to access onsite gyms and fitness studios.
  • FLEXIBLE WORK : At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options : flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.
  • FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE : We understand that together, Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their own individual scopes. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.
  • PAID TIME OFF : We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days paid holiday per year with an additional day for each year of tenure (up to 5) in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!).
  • PARENTAL LEAVE : Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.
  • CAREER GROWTH : Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.
  • CULTURE : An exciting and supportive environment filled with passionate individuals from all over the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day.

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. title: Head Of Finance, Brazil
description:
CONMED Corporation is a progressive, global medical device company, operating in 20 countries. Through thoughtful leadership, innovation and teamwork, we are changing the future of healthcare. Our 3,500 employees worldwide make meaningful contributions, positively impact the business, and advance in their careers as our company and product portfolio grows. We are a leader in Orthopedics, General Surgery, Gynecology, Gastroenterology, Pulmonology, and Anesthesiology and our employees enjoy challenging and diverse job opportunities across these varied specializations. CONMED is headquartered in the United States. Our international presence includes more than 20 locations throughout Canada, Europe, Australia, Latin America, Asia, North America, and the Middle East.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Finance Director for Brazil is responsible for leading all financial operations, ensuring full compliance with local regulations, strengthening internal controls, optimizing financial performance, developing and supporting strategic business objectives. This role is pivotal in elevating governance, audit readiness, and operational discipline across the Brazilian organization.

This role oversees FP&A, Controllership, Reporting, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Internal Controls, Compliance, and Financial Governance, while partnering closely with the Country Manager and regional / global Finance leadership to drive sustainable growth, profitability, strong governance and disciplined execution.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic & Financial Leadership

Develop and execute financial strategies aligned with corporate objectives and Brazil's dynamic economic and regulatory environment.

Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, cash planning, and long‑range planning processes for Brazil.

Serve as a strategic partner to the Country Manager and senior leadership team, providing actionable insights to influence commercial, operational, and organizational decisions.

Monitor market trends, FX volatility, reimbursement dynamics, inflationary pressures, and competitor behavior to inform financial strategy.

Financial Reporting, Compliance & Audit Readiness

Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual closing processes, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and timely reporting under Brazilian GAAP, IFRS, and corporate accounting standards (including US GAAP, if applicable).

Ensure complete, timely, and compliant statutory reporting, tax filings, SPED obligations (ECD / ECF), and other regulatory submissions.

Lead the Brazil Audit Remediation Plan, ensuring closure of all audit findings (high / medium / low risk) within established timelines.

Strengthen governance, documentation discipline, and financial process transparency to achieve "audit‑ready, always" standards.

Manage external relationships with auditors (Big 4), tax authorities, banks, and regulatory bodies, representing the company with professionalism and financial rigor.

Treasury, Cash Flow & Working Capital Management

Own end‑to‑end cash flow, liquidity planning, and working capital performance (AR, AP, inventory).

Lead banking relationships, credit facility management, financial instruments, FX operations, and covenant monitoring.

Optimize capital structure, credit utilization, hedging strategies, and funding needs in alignment with corporate Treasury.

Drive improvements in collections, DSO, inventory turns, and payment terms to enhance cash generation.

Performance Management & Business Partnering

Deliver comprehensive financial analysis, including P&L performance, balance sheet quality, KPI trends, pricing, and margin enhancement opportunities.

Evaluate commercial strategies, business cases, investments, and distributor economics across franchises, customers, and Brazil geographies.

Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, and Operations to improve pricing governance, cost‑to‑serve, product mix optimization, and portfolio profitability.

Internal Controls, Governance & Risk Management

Design, implement, and continuously strengthen internal controls aligned with SOX, corporate governance frameworks, and Brazilian regulatory requirements.

Lead governance of Fixed‑asset tracking and mobility controls, Inventory accuracy, reconciliations, and reporting reliability (including 3PL and distributor consignment).

Build and maintain a comprehensive risk register, governance cadence, and audit calendar.

Systems, ERP & Digital Finance

Lead optimization and governance of ERP and reporting systems, improving data integrity, and reporting accuracy.

Implement analytics and BI tools to enhance management dashboards, forecasting, and business decision‑making.

Team Leadership & Organizational Development

Lead, mentor, and develop a high‑performing Finance organization across Accounting, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, and Controls.

Build strong bench strength and raise capability in financial governance, technical accounting, tax, and analytics.

Lead the team through transformational change, strengthening culture, accountability, and execution discipline.

Foster effective cross‑functional partnerships with Operations, Commercial, Supply Chain, and Service teams.

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience

Minimum 7–10 years in senior finance leadership roles (Finance Director, Country Controller, CFO, or equivalent) within multinational environments.

Proven experience in a similar leadership role or demonstrated potential to successfully assume such responsibilities.

Proven track record in governance turnarounds, internal controls design, and complex compliance environments.

Significant experience managing cash flow, working capital, treasury, and banking relationships.

Demonstrated expertise in Accounting, FP&A, Tax (including indirect taxes), Treasury, and statutory reporting.

Experience in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, or medical devices preferred; understanding of distributors and regulated markets is a plus.

Deep understanding of Brazil's financial, tax, and regulatory landscape.

Strong command of Brazilian GAAP, IFRS, and corporate reporting frameworks including US GAAP.

Advanced analytical thinking with ability to translate data into insights and influence senior decision‑makers.

Strong systems orientation, with hands‑on ERP experience (SAP / Oracle) and BI / reporting tools.

Exceptional communication skills in Portuguese and English, both written and spoken.

Strong leadership presence with the ability to drive accountability, lead change, and elevate organizational capability.

High degree of integrity, assertiveness, discipline, and ownership in managing financial governance.

Education & Credentials

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field (required).

MBA or advanced degree in Finance, Controllership, or related field (preferred).

Professional certification such as CRC, CPA, CMA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

Additional credentials in internal controls, audit, or compliance are a plus.

description:
This is an ideal role for someone who wants to challenge themselves in a fast-paced environment and join a passionate, driven and fun team. If you are a self-starter who is looking to accelerate their career and enjoys problem-solving, then this is the ideal role for you! As a Head of Growth , you will have the opportunity to:

Responsibilities:

  • Take full ownership of performance within your projects and campaigns, analysing data, exploring new opportunities, implementing tests and making ongoing optimisations. The idea for this role is that you will move into managing growth holistically for one of our major categories e.g. hair loss, weight loss etc.
  • Manage budgets to drive maximum returns for the business, in line with target KPIs, forecasting spending and acquisition volume within your areas of responsibility.
  • Collaborate with a high-performing Growth team in Brazil and the UK, sharing results and insights on best practices and performance strategies.
  • Develop internal relationships and collaborations with the rest of the UK and BR team, our category managers, customer insights, creative, medical and product team to understand our customers' needs & behaviours and to translate these insights into copy, landing page tests, creatives, new channel tests etc.
  • Ideate test ideas within the channels that you participate in - landing pages, creative, ad copy, bid strategies, pricing etc.
  • Ideate and create performance creative briefs for paid social channels.
  • Test and own new channels that we don’t currently invest in.
  • Build relationships with external vendors (Google, Meta etc..) to understand best practices, new features and campaign improvement opportunities.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years experience working in digital marketing with strong hands-on experience managing campaigns with significant budgets within Paid Social and Search Engine Marketing (SEM).
  • Strong understands a wide variety of digital marketing channels and how they all fit into the overall marketing mix.
  • Advanced knowledge of Meta Ads, Google Ads and Web Analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics).
  • Familiarity with other channels (TikTok, Twitter, Microsoft, Native, Influencers, SEO, etc.) is a plus.
  • Experience in creative briefing, ad copy and creators/influencers ads.
  • Knowledge of A/B testing, including landing pages.
  • Advanced understanding of data tracking, conversion measurement, attribution and incrementality.
  • Experience with high-growth and/or healthcare businesses is advantageous.
  • Fluent English (mandatory) and Portuguese language skills.

About You:

  • You are a self-starter who can take the initiative, lead a project, own the decisions and proactively look to solve problems.
  • Numbers-oriented, you are highly analytical and love working with data to drive insights and action.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, confident collaborating with multiple stakeholders and managing expectations.
  • Ambitious, keen to learn and ready to grow alongside a rapidly expanding business.
  • You are curious for knowledge, always asking questions, and aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo.

This role offers very competitive pay , benefits, stock options, and the chance to build something big with an exceptional team and proven product-market fit.

Note: We carefully review every application and will be in touch via LinkedIn or e-mail with candidates whose background best fits what we’re looking for.

  • Capacitar, educar e conscientizar, visando o cumprimento da legislação, normas e procedimentos aplicáveis às questões de segurança, meio ambiente, saúde e sistema de gestão integrado relacionadas às diversas atividades da empresa.

  • Conduzir a articulação permanente com a área de saúde para integração do programa de prevenção de riscos.
  • Realizar inspeções de segurança, auditorias comportamentais e de sistemas de gestão, visando à identificação, tratamento e correção de desvios.
  • Representar a empresa perante o cliente e demais órgãos legais em SMS.
  • Identificar novas tendências e inovações em sustentabilidade, implementando melhorias contínuas;

  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as regulamentações de segurança do trabalho.

  • Conhecimento de Sistema de Gestão Integrado
  • Habilidade em liderança de equipe e resolução de problemas
  • Coordenar ações com auditores para garantir a conformidade legal
  • Proatividade na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria contínua e inovação.
  • Conhecimento profundo das normas de segurança do trabalho e regulamentações ambientais específicas para a construção civil pesada.
  • Capacidade de desenvolver relatórios técnicos, analisar dados e gerenciar indicadores.
  • Conhecimento das Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs).
  • Conhecimento das normas ABNT, ISO e Lei 8.213/91.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e liderança.

  • Competitive salary $70k-100k USD per year + Stocks + PTO depending on level and experience
  • Equity in a high-growth startup
  • Comprehensive benefits package (tailored to your location)
  • The opportunity to make a tangible impact on people's lives
  • A collaborative, remote-first culture

Interview Process

  • Screening
  • 45-minute chat with our Head of Product
  • Culture-fit interviews with 2-3 team members across different functions
  • 1-hour technical assessment (collaborative problem-solving)Final interview with founders and offer presentation

A BMZ Advogados Associados é um escritório jurídico especializado em auxílio acidente, com atuação em todo o Brasil e atendimento 100% remoto. Nosso propósito é garantir o acesso à justiça com eficiência, empatia e resultados concretos.

Estamos em fase de crescimento e buscamos um(a) Gerente Sênior de Finanças Estratégicas para liderar a área financeira com foco em análise estratégica, planejamento e controle econômico, contribuindo diretamente para as decisões que sustentam a expansão do escritório.

Missão do Cargo

Ser o ponto focal da estratégia financeira da BMZ, garantindo visão analítica e de futuro sobre o negócio — do controle orçamentário ao planejamento tributário, dos resultados financeiros ao equilíbrio econômico entre os setores.

Responsabilidades Principais

  • Elaborar, acompanhar e revisar o orçamento anual e setorial (8 setores do escritório);
  • Analisar o fluxo de caixa e realizar projeções financeiras de curto, médio e longo prazo;
  • Desenvolver e apresentar relatórios financeiros gerenciais (mensais, trimestrais e anuais) aos sócios;
  • Avaliar rentabilidade, margens e indicadores econômicos por setor e por operação;
  • Realizar planejamento e análise tributária em conjunto com o setor contábil;
  • Fazer estudos de valuation, equilíbrio financeiro e precificação dos serviços;
  • Controlar orçamentos e budgets setoriais, validando despesas e investimentos;
  • Apoiar as decisões estratégicas da diretoria, apresentando insights e recomendações financeiras;
  • Estruturar e otimizar processos financeiros, controles internos e políticas de gestão;
  • Participar ativamente das reuniões de gestão estratégica com os sócios.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade ou Finanças;
  • Experiência sólida em planejamento financeiro, controladoria e análise de resultados;
  • Capacidade de conectar finanças com estratégia de negócios;
  • Conhecimento em planejamento tributário e interpretação de indicadores;
  • Excel avançado e domínio de ferramentas de gestão financeira;
  • Perfil analítico, estratégico e orientado a resultados;
  • Disponibilidade para inicio imediato

Diferenciais

  • Experiência anterior em escritório de advocacia ou empresas de serviços;
  • Vivência com indicadores de performance (KPIs) e automação de relatórios;
  • Conhecimento em ERP / Power BI / sistemas de gestão financeira.

  • Pessoa Jurídica (PJ)
  • Regime Presencial

Role Overview

We are seeking a Hybrid Business Analyst & Scrum Master to support the delivery of Supply Chain Analytics product teams. This role combines deep business and data analysis expertise with Agile leadership to drive insights, improve supply chain performance, and ensure predictable, high-quality delivery.

The successful candidate will partner with planning, logistics, manufacturing, and analytics stakeholders, translating business needs into actionable analytics solutions while facilitating Scrum ceremonies and team execution.

Product & Business Analysis (80%)

Review Power BI reports, semantic models, DAX measures, calculation groups, and Row-Level Security (RLS).

Define, monitor, and improve key supply chain KPIs such as forecast accuracy, inventory turns, OTIF, case fill rate, production adherence, DC throughput, and transportation cost per case.

Scrum Master & Delivery (20%)

Facilitate Agile ceremonies: daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.

Coach teams on Agile principles including transparency, inspection, and iterative delivery.

Maintain backlog health and sprint cadence; leverage velocity, cycle time, and burn metrics to forecast delivery.

Remove impediments and foster collaboration across business, data engineering, analytics, platform, and security teams.

Promote Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD), test automation where applicable, and measurable sprint outcomes.

Communicate progress through roadmaps, dashboards, and stakeholder updates.

Required Qualifications

5–8+ years of experience in Business Analysis or Analytics roles.

3–5+ years of experience as a Scrum Master.

Strong hands‑on experience with Snowflake, SQL, and Power BI (DAX, RLS, data modeling).

Solid understanding of data modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, and data quality frameworks.

Experience in CPG supply chain domains (demand planning, inventory, production, logistics).

Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Certifications: CSM/PSM, PL-300, SnowPro Core

Experience with SAP, Blue Yonder, or Kinaxis

Knowledge of S&OP, APS, ERP (SAP ECC/S4), TMS, and WMS data structures and integrations

Familiarity with data governance frameworks (stewardship, cataloging, quality rules)

Snowflake, SQL

Power BI (Desktop & Service)

Data Catalog/Governance tools (e.g., Collibra)

ERP/APS/TMS/WMS integrations

Business Impact

Improve service levels, inventory turns, forecast accuracy, and cost-to-serve.

Increase analytics reliability, scalability, and stakeholder adoption.

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
We Are Sportingtech :

Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. Our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.

Who are You ?

You are relentlessly committed to delivering exceptional partner support, combining deep technical knowledge with sharp analytical skills to resolve issues efficiently and prevent them from recurring. You excel at interpreting data, logs, and system behavior to uncover root causes and provide clear, actionable insights to both partners and internal teams.

A confident and influential communicator, you build strong relationships with operators, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams. You thrive on translating complex technical details into understandable guidance, ensuring that partners always feel supported and informed.

Where you Fit In:

We are seeking a proactive and technically strong B2B Technical Support Specialist to join our growing team. In this role, you will leverage your deep understanding of the iGaming industry and your strong analytical mindset to troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve issues reported by our operators and internal stakeholders.

Working closely with the ITSM department — and reporting directly to the Technical Support Team Lead — you will be a key player in ensuring high-quality, timely support. Your ability to interpret logs, analyze platform behavior, communicate clearly, and elevate effectively will help maintain platform reliability and deliver an exceptional partner experience.

You will thrive in a fast-paced environment where attention to detail, technical curiosity, and a commitment to service excellence are essential. Your work will be pivotal in strengthening partner trust, improving operational stability, and supporting our mission to deliver a seamless and compliant gaming experience worldwide.

The impact you will have:

  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for B2B operators, platform partners, and integrators, ensuring their issues are resolved quickly, accurately, and with minimal business impact.
  • Perform in-depth technical troubleshooting across game integrations, wallet systems, API calls, transaction flows, and platform services — using logs, monitoring tools, and diagnostics to identify root causes.
  • Identify, flag, and track repetitive issues or recurring error patterns, escalating them with clear technical context to drive permanent fixes.
  • Ensure all partner interactions, escalations, and resolutions align with regulatory requirements, internal controls, and jurisdictional rules — maintaining strong compliance awareness at all times.
  • Coordinate cross-team escalations ensuring that complex issues are escalated and documented clearly and progressed efficiently.
  • Stay current with industry standards, emerging technologies, and best practices across iGaming, payments, and platform operations, recommending improvements to processes and tooling.
  • Champion adoption of shared support frameworks — authoring playbooks, SLA policies, runbooks, and knowledge-base articles to standardize excellence across the organization.

What we’re looking for:

  • Experience in B2B Technical Support within the Casino or iGaming sector.
  • Strong understanding of iGaming systems such as game aggregation, wallet services, RNG, bonus engines, player tracking, and jurisdictional compliance.
  • Experience working with logs, monitoring tools, and debugging complex integration issues.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple cases, partners, and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent English communication and presentation skills.
  • Hands-on experience with common support tooling (ex: Jira, Grafana, Kibana, etc.).

This role is remote and based in Brazil.

Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

title: Healthcare Recruiter
description:
Full Spectrum Search Group is a U.S.-based executive search firm specializing in leadership recruiting within senior living, skilled nursing, home health, and hospice.

About the Role

We are hiring an Appointment Setter based in São Paulo, Brazil to support our U.S. recruiting and business development efforts. This role works directly with executives and decision-makers in the United States. Fluent, professional English (spoken and written) is required. Prior experience working with U.S.-based companies or clients is also required.

This role will start off as an appointment setter to learn our industry, with a growth path into a full desk recruiter.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct outbound phone calls to U.S.-based executives and decision-makers
  • Set qualified meetings for senior sales and recruiting leaders
  • Deliver outreach through phone, email, SMS, and digital channels
  • Follow structured call scripts and messaging frameworks
  • Work closely with leadership to refine outreach strategy and improve conversion rates
  • Maintain accurate notes and activity tracking in the CRM
  • Consistently meet or exceed appointment-setting and conversion targets
  • Prioritize daily activities based on business needs and active searches

Qualifications

  • Fluent or near-native English required, with a professional speaking voice
  • Demonstrated experience working with U.S.-based companies, clients, or teams
  • Prior experience in appointment setting, sales development, recruiting support, or outbound calling preferred
  • Comfortable speaking with senior executives over the phone
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, performance-driven environment
  • Experience with CRM systems is a plus (training provided if needed)

Required Skills

  • Strong phone presence and confidence in live conversations
  • Excellent listening skills and attention to detail
  • Professional, positive, and resilient mindset
  • Ability to build rapport quickly with U.S. executives
  • Self-motivated and competitive, with a desire to improve performance
  • Comfortable following scripts while adapting naturally in conversation
  • Reliable internet connection and quiet work environment

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with CRM systems

Pay range and compensation package

Competitive compensation aligned to Brazilian market standards. Performance-based incentives available based on meeting and conversion metrics.

Missão do cargo

Desenvolver, manter e evoluir soluções com qualidade, usabilidade, desempenho e inovação, dentro dos prazos acordados, com supervisão mínima; tendo como foco a evolução da gestão em nossos clientes.

Todas as nossas vagas estão disponíveis para pessoas com deficiência!

Que tal se juntar ao nosso time e embarcar nessa jornada com a gente?

  • Interpretar requisitos funcionais criando vínculos entre estes e as modificações necessárias na solução;
  • Definir requisitos não-funcionais inerentes ao atendimento das necessidades de cada projeto, levando em conta todos os níveis lógicos da solução (camadas de apresentação, aplicação, banco de dados, etc);
  • Propor e desenvolver soluções para problemas que envolvam as áreas da Ciência da Computação e / ou Engenharia de Software;
  • Definir e desenvolver estratégias de integração com serviços e aplicações de terceiros;
  • Estimar custos e prazos para o desenvolvimento / manutenção da solução;
  • Negociar com clientes internos acerca de requisitos, recursos, custos e prazos de projetos e ajustes nas soluções / ferramentas;
  • Negociar com clientes externos acerca de requisitos, recursos, custos e prazos de projetos e ajustes nas soluções / ferramentas;
  • Escrever código legível, manutenível e robusto que atenda totalmente os requisitos funcionais e não-funcionais do projeto, sempre atento aos padrões utilizados pela empresa, garantindo a qualidade e funcionamento do que foi criado ou modificado;
  • Criar novos recursos e funcionalidades dentro do sistema ou em ferramentas auxiliares;
  • Desenvolver APIs e novas ferramentas utilitárias;
  • Realizar profiling e depuração de rotinas visando encontrar e mitigar problemas de desempenho;
  • Criar ajustes e melhorias que visem aumentar o desempenho (Tunning);

Executar manutenção corretiva, evolutiva e adaptativa em código e rotinas pré-existentes

  • Realizar revisão das tarefas de seus pares;
  • Realizar mentoring e acompanhamento de novos membros da equipe;
  • Liderar colegas em projetos que envolvam vários desenvolvedores;
  • Tomar decisões rápidas e assertivas acerca de problemas técnicos encontrados em projetos e / ou manutenção das soluções;
  • Gerar documentação técnica que será usada como base para o documentador gerar manuais / helps para usuários finais do que foi criado / modificado com qualidade e assertividade;

Realizar o apontamento das atividades no sistema de controle da produção da empresa.

Requisitos e qualificações

Proficiência em Java e bons conhecimentos em Kotlin ou Python .

Sólido conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, bem como domínio da linguagem SQL para consultas e manipulação de dados.

Familiaridade com frameworks e tecnologias modernas, como Spring, React e Node.js .

Experiência em metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento de software, como Scrum ou Kanban .

Prática com integração contínua (CI), entrega contínua (CD) e automação de testes .

Compreensão e aplicação de princípios de arquitetura de software, incluindo: Arquitetura em camadas, Microserviços, APIs RESTful, Escalabilidade e Alta disponibilidade.

Experiência com desenvolvimento de aplicações web

title: Especialista Em Segurança De Processos - Indústria
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose / ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Sobre a Função

Atuar como responsável por garantir a integridade e a confiabilidade operacional das unidades industriais, prevenindo incidentes relacionados a falhas de processo. Atuar na análise, monitoramento e melhoria contínua dos sistemas de gestão de segurança de processos (PSM), apoiando áreas de operação, manutenção e engenharia na identificação, avaliação e controle de riscos industriais.

Atividades principais

Conduzir e apoiar estudos de análise de risco, como HAZOP, HAZID, What If, LOPA e Análise de Árvores de Eventos.

Desenhar, desenvolver, revisar e atualizar os padrões de operações de equipamentos e processos operacionais em conjunto com a equipe de operação industrial

Monitorar indicadores de segurança de processos e elaborar planos de ação para mitigação de riscos.

Garantir conformidade com requisitos legais, normas técnicas e padrões corporativos (NRs, API, NFPA, OSHA PSM, ISO, entre outros).

Avaliar mudanças de processo por meio de metodologias de Gestão de Mudança (MOC).

Participar do desenvolvimento e validação de sistemas de proteção, como instrumentação de segurança (SIS) e camadas independentes de proteção.

Suportar projetos de engenharia garantindo que requisitos de segurança estejam incorporados desde a concepção.

Garantir que os sistemas de prevenção e combate a incêndios estejam instalados, funcionando adequadamente e em conformidade com a legislação vigente, realizando inspeções e manutenções periódicas nos equipamentos

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. *Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub!

With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are hiring a Senior Data Engineer for our CARE - Deep Individual Data team in Portugal! This is a Remote – Portugal position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Portugal.

Join our growing CARE (Coach on Artificial Intelligence for Real Engagement) team at Wellhub and help us build the next generation of AI-powered solutions. This role focuses on organizing and leveraging digital information about users and people to enhance user experience and recommendations.

This project involves collecting user data from various sources in multiple formats (photo, video, text, audio). You will be instrumental in processing, analyzing, and utilizing this data to improve the user experience, user recommendations, business insights, and overall platform quality. Such candidates must be avid learners and be prepared to learn quickly.

We use data and software engineering principles to solve large-scale production challenges. Our infrastructure is completely in the cloud, running many more cutting‑edge projects.

  • You will develop and maintain data models and structures that enable efficient querying and analysis;

  • You have worked collaboratively to collect, prepare and analyze complex business data
  • You can engage engineering and product teams to elicit requirements and present solutions to top management

  • You can collaborate with different teams to understand data needs and develop effective data pipelines
  • You are comfortable understanding big data concepts to ingest, process, and make data available for data scientists, business analysts, and product teams
  • You are comfortable maintaining data consistency across the entire data ecosystem
  • You are motivated to contribute to a data‑driven culture and see the impact of your work reflected company‑wide

We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in Data Modeling and Data Pipelines is a mandatory requirement.

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

WELLHUB:

We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. CAREER GROWTH:

Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

CULTURE:

Our journey began as an agency, and we’ve already helped thousands of clients succeed. Now, we’re embracing an exciting new chapter: becoming a SaaS‑first company. We're seeking a battle‑tested WordPress Developer & Landing Page Team Lead who has personally managed the technical execution of high‑stakes marketing campaigns with millions of dollars in ad spend.

This isn't a role for someone who's built a few landing pages—we need someone who has been the person responsible for ensuring every pixel fires correctly, every form submits properly, and every dollar of ad spend has a clear path to conversion tracking.

You’ll lead a team of two WordPress developers, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining the exacting standards required when significant marketing budgets are on the line. You’ll be the technical bridge between our marketing campaigns (primarily Meta, but across various channels) and our HubSpot CRM, ensuring flawless data flow and attribution tracking.

Landing Page Development & Campaign Execution

HubSpot Integration & Data Management

Technical Leadership & Team Management

  • Create project timelines and ensure on‑time delivery of campaign assets
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges

Quality Assurance & Risk Management

Required Qualifications

5+ years of professional WordPress development experience

  • Direct experience managing technical execution of marketing campaigns with $1M+ in total ad spend

Technical Expertise

Must be proficient in automating deployment across environments (Dev, Staging, Prod) and integrating unit and end‑to‑end tests into the workflow.
  • Expert‑level WordPress development skills including ACF, Gutenberg, custom theme development, plugin customization, and advanced page builders (Elementor, Divi, or similar)
  • Deep understanding of Meta Business Suite, Meta Pixel implementation, and Conversions API
  • Proven experience with HubSpot CRM integration, forms, and tracking implementation
  • Experience with VueJS (plus)
  • Experience with conversion tracking pixels across multiple platforms (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Google Tag Manager and server‑side tracking implementations
  • Understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, and conversion optimization principles

Management & Communication

  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring developers
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high‑priority projects
  • Clear communication style with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable with accountability when significant marketing budgets are at stake
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to marketing team members

Performance Standards

  • Meticulous attention to detail—one misconfigured pixel can cost thousands in wasted ad spend
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight campaign launch deadlines
  • Proactive problem‑solver who anticipates issues before they become problems
  • Commitment to continuous learning as platforms and tracking methods evolve

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond HubSpot (Marketo, Pardot, ActiveCampaign)
  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies and tools
  • Knowledge of SQL for custom reporting and data analysis
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms (VWO, Optimizely, Google Optimize)
  • Understanding of SEO best practices for landing pages
  • Certifications in Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics, or HubSpot
  • Experience in agency or fast‑paced startup environments

What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Meet with marketing team to understand campaign objectives and conversion goals
  • Review existing team workflows and identify optimization opportunities
  • Successfully launch first campaign under your management with zero tracking issues

First 90 Days

  • Establish standardized QA protocols and documentation for all campaign launches
  • Implement improvements to team efficiency and project management processes
  • Build trust with marketing team through flawless technical execution
  • Identify and resolve any lingering tracking or integration issues

First Year

  • Demonstrably improve landing page conversion rates through testing and optimization
  • Establish Olly Olly's landing page function as a competitive advantage
  • Develop your team members' skills and create succession planning

Why This Role Matters

When we invest in marketing campaigns, every dollar needs to count. You’ll be the person ensuring that our tracking is accurate, our data is clean, and our ability to optimize is never compromised by technical issues. Your work directly impacts our ability to scale profitably and serve more small business owners.

Competitive pay based on your experience.

At Olly Olly, we celebrate differences in background, culture, abilities, and perspectives because diversity drives innovation and creativity. Your voice matters here, it really does! And your unique perspective will help us shape the future of small business growth.

description:

  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.

O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.

Como será seu dia-a-dia?

Seu dia-a-dia será dinâmico e desafiador, com atividades que envolvem desde o desenvolvimento de pipelines de integração e entrega contínuas, até a manutenção de infraestrutura cloud.

Você terá a oportunidade de atuar em empresas de grande porte, auxiliando a equipe a alcançar resultados mais rápidos e eficientes através da adoção de metodologias ágeis e da automação de processos. Incluindo atividades como:

  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes de infraestrutura cloud.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC), utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, CloudFormation ou Azure Resource Manager.
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD, automatizando processos de integração e entrega contínuas.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras e de configuração.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua no processo de entrega de software e implementação de otimizações.
  • Resolver incidentes e problemas de produção de maneira rápida e eficaz, garantindo a estabilidade dos sistemas.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares e comunicar-se efetivamente com outras áreas da empresa.

Resultados esperados incluem

a otimização do tempo de desenvolvimento, a redução do tempo de lançamento de nova versões em produção e a melhoria contínua do processo de entrega de software. Exemplos de entregáveis incluem a configuração e manutenção de ambientes de infraestrutura cloud, o desenvolvimento de scripts de automação de tarefas e pipelines de CI/CD, além da resolução de incidentes e problemas de produção.

Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Experiência com plataformas de orquestração de containers, como Kubernetes, Docker Swarm ou Openshift
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de configuração, como Ansible, Puppet e Chef
  • Experiência em linguagens de programação, como Python, Ruby ou Go, para automatizar tarefas e desenvolver pipelines de CI/CD
  • Conhecimento em práticas DevOps e metodologias ágeis
  • Familiaridade com infraestruturas cloud, como AWS, Azure ou GCP
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento (Observabilidade) e gerenciamento de LOGs, como Datadog, NewRelic, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana e Elasticsearch

title: Líder De Atendimento Ao Cliente
description:
A Floripa Calistenia é o maior perfil de calistenia do Brasil no Instagram e existe por um motivo simples: levar a calistenia para o máximo de pessoas possível — como um treino democrático , que pode ser feito por qualquer um , em qualquer lugar, com o próprio corpo e consistência.

Nosso trabalho é transformação real: ajudamos alunos a evoluírem em força, estética, disciplina e performance através de produtos digitais, comunidade ativa e acompanhamento. Hoje somos uma operação com mentalidade de crescimento, rodando um modelo always-on de vendas e aquisição (Direct Response + performance), e estamos acelerando a estrutura para acompanhar o volume e elevar ainda mais a experiência do aluno.

Por isso, estamos abrindo a posição de Responsável de Customer Success (CS) / Suporte (Head em formação) para construir o setor do zero dentro da operação. Hoje o CS ainda está em fase inicial: precisamos de alguém com mão na massa + cabeça de processos , que entre com mentalidade de dono(a) para organizar a casa, padronizar atendimento, implementar ferramentas (helpdesk/CRM), criar rotinas e indicadores — e transformar suporte em experiência premium , com impacto direto em retenção, satisfação, reputação e receita .

Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto

Preferência: pessoas em Florianópolis (ou região) para encontros presenciais periódicos e maior integração com o time — mas a vaga está aberta para candidatos(as) de outras cidades, desde que tenham autonomia e bagagem para tocar a área em alto padrão.

Objetivo do cargo (o que esperamos de você)

Ser a pessoa responsável por garantir que:

  • O cliente receba acesso rápido , seja bem orientado e tenha suporte eficiente;
  • O CS funcione como um sistema (ferramentas + processos + equipe + métricas);
  • A operação tenha visibilidade real de KPIs críticos (reembolso, chargeback, motivos, SLA);
  • O CS gera impacto direto em lucro, reputação e retenção .

Responsabilidades (o que você vai fazer) 1) Estruturar e operar o CS no dia a dia (hands-on no início)

  • Centralizar e organizar os canais de atendimento (WhatsApp/e-mail/Instagram/comunidade, conforme cenário)
  • Criar fluxo de triagem, prioridades, SLAs, rotinas diárias e follow-ups
  • Construir base de respostas rápidas (macros) e padronização de comunicação
  • Implementar e manter um playbook de suporte (acesso, onboarding, dúvidas, técnico, reembolso)

2) Implantar ferramentas e “sistema de CS”

  • Selecionar, implementar e configurar uma ferramenta de Helpdesk/CRM (tickets, tags, relatórios, SLA)
  • Criar taxonomia de tags/categorias (motivo do contato + motivo raiz)
  • Criar dashboard e rotina de relatórios (semanal e mensal), mesmo que comece via planilha

3) KPIs e performance (impacto real no negócio)

Monitorar e reportar indicadores como:

  • tempo de 1ª resposta , tempo de resolução , backlog
  • save rate (reembolsos evitados/recuperados)
  • principais motivos e motivos raiz de reembolso e suporte

Criar plano de ação para reduzir reembolsos/chargebacks e diminuir volume de tickets repetidos

  • Levar feedbacks reais dos clientes para melhorias de onboarding, conteúdo e produto
  • Consolidar objeções, dúvidas e confusões para ajudar Marketing/Copy a alinhar expectativa e comunicação

5) Escala e liderança (evolução para Head)

  • Documentar processos, criar treinamento e padrão de qualidade
  • Definir estrutura de time (N1/N2/QA, quando fizer sentido)
  • Participar de contratação e gestão de equipe no crescimento do setor

O que é sucesso nos primeiros 30–60–90 dias

  • Helpdesk/CRM escolhido e implantado
  • SLAs definidos e operação rodando com padrão
  • Macros + playbook v1 + relatório semanal com KPIs
  • Queda de tickets repetidos por melhoria de onboarding/FAQ
  • Estrutura de motivos raiz consolidada
  • Rotina de reembolso/chargeback com métricas de contato e “salvamento”
  • CS funcionando como sistema (processo + qualidade + dados)
  • Plano de escala e contratação desenhado (se necessário)
  • Relatório mensal com impacto e prioridades claras

Requisitos (o que você precisa ter)

title: Engenheiro De Dados - Líder Técnico
description:
A VMBears é uma empresa jovem e moderna com o objetivo de ajudar seus clientes a aproveitar novas tecnologias para acelerar seus negócios. Fornece serviços de consultoria para arquitetura corporativa e modernização de sistemas para nuvem. Fundada em 2018, possui em seu DNA a ética, a positividade, o comprometimento e a inovação. Somos focados em oferecer os melhores serviços prestados através dos melhores profissionais do mercado. Esses recursos são utilizados para auxiliar os clientes em sua jornada de modernização tecnológica e transformação digital. O que buscamos?

O Engenheiro(a) de Dados é o profissional que constrói e mantém a infraestrutura responsável por mover, transformar e disponibilizar dados com confiabilidade e performance. Um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados eficaz domina pipelines batch + streaming, otimiza consultas em data-warehouses colunares e garante a rastreabilidade ponta-a-ponta de cada registro. Na prática, atua como elo entre arquitetura e desenvolvimento, permanecendo intrinsecamente ligado(a) ao código que sustenta o fluxo de informações.

Na VMBears, o Engenheiro(a) de Dados é o(a) guardião(ã) da qualidade dos dados : projeta pipelines escaláveis, monitora sua saúde em produção e antecipa gargalos. Para este projeto, a modernização de um motor de cálculo de alto volume no setor de energia, buscamos alguém que una profundidade técnica em processamento distribuído e lakehouse a uma mentalidade de produto baseada em dados.

Você integrará o squad que modernizará o Motor de Cálculo, um engine que processa bilhões de registros, aplica centenas de fórmulas regulatórias e gera resultados contábeis que movem o mercado de energia elétrica. Procuramos alguém que combine habilidade de modelar dados massivos com espírito de colaboração, ajudando o time a migrar de um monolito PL / SQL para uma plataforma distribuída, event-driven e cloud-native, onde cada byte chegue rápido, íntegro e auditável ao novo motor.

Responsabilidades :

  • Implementar soluções com arquitetura de dados distribuída, garantindo latência e throughput que atendam aos requisitos da do negócio;
  • Implantar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e publicação que suportem batch + streaming em larga escala;
  • Seguir padrões de versionamento, catalogação e lineage de dados para rastreabilidade de processamento;
  • Desenvolver processos sempre visando o menor custo e maior performance em Redshift / BigQuery / Athena, propondo ajustes de partição, compressão e caching;
  • Documentar processos e fluxos de trabalho de dados : Manter registros detalhados dos processos de dados para facilitar a manutenção e a melhoria contínua;

Projetar sistemas que possam crescer conforme a demanda por dados aumenta.

Stack desejável :

Terraform / IaC, CI / CD Git, testes de dados automatizados, segurança LGPD (IAM fine-grained, encryption at rest / in transit).

Requisitos imprescindíveis :

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada;

Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro de Dados : Ter um histórico sólido na área de engenharia de dados. Pensamento lógico e solução de problemas complexos.

Proficiência em alguma linguagem de programação (Python, Java e outras) e SQL : Ser capaz de usar essas linguagens de programação para manipular e gerenciar dados.

Conhecimento em tecnologias de big data : Familiaridade com ferramentas que permitem o processamento de grandes volumes de dados.

Experiência com sistemas de gerenciamento de banco de dados : Saber como projetar e manter bancos de dados eficientes. Organização para gerenciar grandes volumes de dados e processos críticos.

Habilidades de resolução de problemas e pensamento analítico : Capacidade de identificar e resolver problemas complexos de dados. Habilidade de documentação e boas práticas em arquitetura de dados.

description:
Missão do cargo

Garantir excelência operacional financeira e, ao mesmo tempo, estruturar a camada de controladoria e performance para sustentar escala: mais previsibilidade, mais velocidade de decisão e melhor eficiência de crescimento.

title: Auxiliar De Suprimentos I - Farmácia Hospitalar - Santa Casada Bahia
description:
Ficamos felizes pelo seu interesse em participar da nossa equipe de colaboradores, que já soma aproximadamente 5.500 funcionários.

Antes de sabermos mais sobre suas características profissionais, convidamos você a conhecer um pouco da história da Santa Casa da

Bahia, instituição filantrópica que se propõe ao objetivo de ajudar aos mais necessitados.

Foi no ano de 1549, quando Tomé de Sousa ocupava o posto de governador-geral do Brasil, que foi construída uma casa de taipa e palha, no Centro Histórico de Salvador, que por cerca de 200 anos abrigou o Hospital de Caridade, primeiro hospital do Estado da Bahia, sendo o único a prestar assistência aos baianos na época.

Somente em 30 de julho de 1893 foi construído o Hospital Santa Izabel (HSI), no bairro de Nazaré, em Salvador, desativando a antiga

unidade de saúde que funcionava no Pelourinho. O prédio do primeiro hospital passou a ser a sede administrativa da Santa Casa da Bahia e, em 2006, se tornou o Museu da Misericórdia.

A Santa Casa da Bahia é uma associação beneficente de assistência social, que se propõe ao exercício da caridade e prestação de

serviços nas áreas de saúde, ensino, pesquisa, cultura, assistência social e educação, sem subordinação ao Estado ou à Igreja.
